title: Gross-to-net irrigation through an explicit canopy store

dependency_gate.implementation_rule: No DUMMY-15D model or tests before DUMMY-15C closes and the implementation baseline is rebound.

purpose: Insert the minimum canopy/interception state between externally supplied gross irrigation and net soil irrigation so that source withdrawal, canopy storage change, interception evaporation and soil input have distinct ledger ownership before real Rutter substitution.

production_authority_basis.restricted_irrigation_binding: F-APP07 binds gross scheduled irrigation into Rutter and F-APP08 binds Rutter net irrigation into dynamic top.

analytical_transfers.G: gross supplied irrigation withdrawn from the surface-water source
analytical_transfers.I: intercepted part of gross irrigation entering canopy storage
analytical_transfers.N: net irrigation bypassing/reaching the soil top
analytical_transfers.E_i: interception evaporation leaving the represented water system
analytical_transfers.V: optional reciprocal surface-groundwater exchange retained from the qualified shared-state ledger

canopy_inside.interpretation: Gross irrigation and surface-groundwater exchange are internal transfers; only interception evaporation leaves.

canopy_outside.interpretation: Canopy storage change becomes a boundary term when canopy state is excluded.

falsification_cases.name: gross_mistaken_for_net
falsification_cases.error: Apply G=20 directly to root instead of N=15 while also storing intercepted water.
falsification_cases.expected_failure: creates +5 m3 duplicate water in root+canopy representation

falsification_cases.name: net_mistaken_for_source_withdrawal
falsification_cases.error: Withdraw only N=15 from surface source while canopy still receives I=5.
falsification_cases.expected_failure: creates +5 m3 water because intercepted water has no source withdrawal

falsification_cases.name: canopy_omitted_without_boundary_term
falsification_cases.error: Exclude canopy store but compare represented balance only against E_i.
falsification_cases.expected_failure: apparent 3 m3 mass defect equal to Delta C

hypotheses: The canonical four-store ledger closes exactly to -2 m3, equal only to interception evaporation.
Surface-groundwater exchange V cancels exactly from the full ledger even when canopy interception is active.
When canopy is excluded from the represented system, the correct boundary loss is E_i + Delta C = 5 m3, not E_i alone.
Using gross irrigation as soil-top input double-counts the intercepted amount.
Using net irrigation as Ribasim/source withdrawal creates the intercepted amount from nowhere.
A later real Rutter substitution must compare gross supplied source withdrawal to gross irrigation and compare net soil input separately; one number cannot serve both roles.
boundaries: first-stage DUMMY-15D uses prescribed G/I/N/E_i amounts rather than reproducing Rutter nonlinear/event branching
authority_rebind_note: DUMMY-15D was preregistered while DUMMY-15C was blocked. No executable DUMMY-15D implementation existed. Baseline rebound to the post-DUMMY-15C closeout head before creating DUMMY-15D model/tests.
